propositions: Define immutable operation/outcome contract with canonical logical_id and provider-neutral Disposition/FailureScope/ReplaySafety/DelaySource enums that serialize to byte-identical UTF-8 JSON via canonical_bytes seam.
Implement sole three-invocation, 15-second fake-clock retry budget owner in reconciler domain; adapter layers report one physical invocation at a time without sleeping or replaying.

Bounded diagnostic entries (max eight) with allowlist-restricted keys (stage, category, status_code, provider_code, retry_after_ms, message), centralized redaction via sanitize_diagnostic seam, and 512-code-point truncation with overflow sentinel.

Retry schedule uses zero-based index producing [2s,3s) then [4s,5s) delays via 2**(retry_index+1)+U[0,1) formula; authoritative provider delays are lower bounds never shortened; over-budget delays return retry_not_before without work.

After ambiguous write, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; observed desired state produces recovered; conclusive old state replays only within remaining budget; failed or inconclusive observation produces non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden.

ADR 0103 records retry ownership, Jira non-idempotency, observe-before-replay lifecycle, selected-route-only deltas, and retention of ADR 0084 additive jitter while rejecting decorrelated jitter for two bounded sleeps.
